title: Deidentified Ai
definition: A blank canvas AI model that can be imbued with a specific identity, enabling it to generate personalized content.

difficulty_levels.beginner: An AI model that can be given a unique personality or character, allowing it to generate personalized content.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: An AI model designed to be imbued with a specific identity, allowing it to generate content tailored to that identity.
difficulty_levels.expert: An AI model that can be given a unique identity, enabling it to generate content that is personalized to that identity, offering new possibilities for AI applications.

extra_fields.insight: AI models can be imbued with a specific identity to generate personalized content.
